title: analytics: the draft preview serves a column raw beside its own time bucket, while native and ObjectQL refuse it with INVALID_QUERY
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28744 dev (PR #28762, os-dev-report `6561934975` on #28744), class a, measured. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim.

Reach: `queryDataset`, measured on real SQLite at `c8c555f7`. A query with `dimensions: [closed_at]` and `timeDimensions: [{ dimension: OBJECT.closed_at, granularity: month }]` asks for one column raw and also bucketed by month. The native and ObjectQL strategies refuse it with `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 ("groupBy.1.field names the column closed_at, which groupBy.0 already names"). The draft preview (`previewDrafts: true`) serves it and answers both, raw instants and months. PR #28762 keeps the live refusal on purpose and pins it, because two values under one name is a real conflict, not a duplicate key.

Business reason: an author who checks a dataset in the draft preview sees an answer that the published dataset then refuses, so the preview approves a query the live faces never serve. This is the same three-face parity line as #28555 and #28690–#28692.

## Wanted

The draft preview answers a column raw beside its own time bucket the same way the live faces do: the same `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 with the same message. ⛔ The live refusal does not move. A raw dimension beside a bucket of a *different* column, and two dimensions over one column with no bucket (#28744), stay served.

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed issues for `raw beside bucket`, `own month bucket preview` and `preview timeDimensions granularity raw INVALID_QUERY`: only #28744 (two names over one column, the opposite face) and #16178 (closed, driver-memory granularity). **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`, the preview path).

Links back: #28744, PR #28762, #28555, #28692
